comparison.objective: Install a rack rail versus seat a syringe and advance a pump driver without dosing.
comparison.physical_skill: Long-rail alignment, spring latching, telescoping and screw driving versus delicate flange-slot placement and guarded linear approach.
comparison.success_condition: Four engaged prongs, level registration and correct screws versus submillimetric syringe seating and driver contact with plunger travel at most 1 mm.
comparison.reason: The syringe task tests precision placement without actuation; the candidate tests load-bearing staged attachment. Candidate force thresholds are missing but not needed to distinguish them.
